result.rationale: Applying DGF-decision-v8 evaluate_legal to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_LEGAL snapshot (design phase) yields three triggered predicates. (1) LEGAL-DPA-001 (critical): project personal_data = true while dpa_status = "missing"; the DPA document corroborates ("Status | missing") and the MSA clause 4 states "DPA status: missing". Action EXECUTE_DPA, owner Legal / Privacy, disposition REWORK, risk acceptance NOT allowed. (2) LEGAL-AUDIT-001 (high): audit_right = "reports_only", which is in the insufficient set ('reports_only','none'); MSA clause 7 confirms "Customer audit rights: reports_only", and the authoritative CONTRACT_PLAYBOOK requires audit_right "full or limited". Action REDLINE_AUDIT_RIGHT, owner Legal, disposition REWORK, risk acceptance allowed. (3) LEGAL-INS-001 (high): insurance_valid = false; MSA clause 10 confirms "Certificate valid: False". Action OBTAIN_VALID_INSURANCE, owner Supplier, disposition SUSPENSION, risk acceptance NOT allowed. Non-triggered predicates verified: LEGAL-LIAB-001 (liability_cap_multiplier = 5, not 0.5, and security_carveout = true); LEGAL-EXIT-001 (exit_assistance_days = 180, not 0); LEGAL-IP-001 (ip_ownership = "vendor", not "ambiguous"); LEGAL-SIGN-001 (signing_authority_valid = true); LEGAL-LOG-001 (log_export_clause = "limited", not "missing"). Gate rollup is the highest-severity triggered disposition: SUSPENSION (from LEGAL-INS-001) outranks REWORK. SUSPENSION is in the policy's authorization_required_for list, so standing-mandate authorization is required; however the active mandate MANDATE-...-INTEGRATE-04-LEGAL-1 covers 'all and only risk-acceptable findings', and the blocking LEGAL-INS-001 (and LEGAL-DPA-001) have risk_acceptance_allowed=false, so the mandate cannot authorize acceptance of them and no conditional approval is available. Proposed actions are remediations, not completed remediation; the snapshot reflects the submitted state only.
